careers.title: AI/ML Engineer
careers.tagline: Build systems that learn from data and automate complex tasks.

overview.description: Develop, evaluate, and ship neural networks and statistical models that power real-time inference, search, robotics, and natural language understanding.
overview.education: B.Tech/B.S. in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or equivalent portfolio.
responsibilities: Architect, train, and benchmark deep learning models for classification, regression, and generation.
Construct scalable feature extraction and dataset preparation pipelines.
Profile latency and optimize inference on GPU, TPU, and edge microcontrollers.
Deploy containerized inference endpoints through REST and gRPC architectures.

careers.title: Data Analyst
careers.tagline: Turn numbers into actionable business insights.

overview.description: Extract, clean, and visualize enterprise metrics to empower leadership to make high-impact data-driven decisions.
overview.education: Degree in Business, Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Engineering, or relevant certification.
responsibilities: Query relational databases and cloud data warehouses with optimized SQL.
Synthesize exploratory data findings into interactive dashboards.
Identify seasonal variances, user funnel drop-offs, and operational bottlenecks.

careers.title: Cloud & DevOps Engineer
careers.tagline: Architect robust, scalable cloud infrastructure and CI/CD automation.

overview.description: Manage scalable cloud resources across AWS, GCP, and Azure, orchestrating automated CI/CD deployment pipelines.
overview.education: Degree in IT, Computer Science, or Cloud Certifications (AWS Solutions Architect / CKA).
responsibilities: Deploy microservices with high availability and self-healing resilience.
Maintain CI/CD automation pipelines for automated test and delivery.
Monitor infrastructure reliability, response latency, and disaster recovery.

careers.title: Product UX/UI Designer
careers.tagline: Craft intuitive, delightful user experiences for digital products.

overview.description: Conduct user research, design wireframes, high-fidelity prototypes, and design systems for mobile and web apps.
overview.education: Degree in Design, HCI, Multimedia, or demonstrated design portfolio.
responsibilities: Conduct qualitative and quantitative user interviews to discover pain points.
Build wireframes, interactive prototypes, and design tokens.
Test prototypes with users and iterate designs based on behavioral analytics.

careers.title: Cybersecurity Analyst
careers.tagline: Defend computer networks and systems against malicious attacks.

overview.description: Monitor security operations centers (SOC), identify network vulnerabilities, and respond to cyber threat intrusions.
overview.education: B.Tech/B.Sc. in Computer Science or Security certifications (CompTIA Security+, CEH).
responsibilities: Inspect security logs for abnormal intrusion patterns.
Perform vulnerability scans and coordinate system patching.
Formulate incident response playbooks and data recovery plans.

courses.title: Machine Learning Specialization
courses.eligibility: Basic high-school mathematics and introductory Python syntax knowledge.
courses.about: A foundational online program co-created by DeepLearning.AI and Stanford Online teaching core machine learning algorithms and practical implementation.
youLearn: Supervised machine learning (Linear regression, logistic regression, decision trees)
Unsupervised learning (K-means, PCA, anomaly detection, recommender systems)
Reinforcement learning and neural network training best practices

courses.title: CS50x: Introduction to Computer Science
courses.eligibility: Open to anyone with no prior programming experience required.
courses.about: Harvard University's flagship introduction to the intellectual enterprises of computer science and the art of programming.
youLearn: Algorithmic thinking and efficient problem solving
Low-level concepts: C, memory management, pointers, and data structures
High-level programming: Python, SQL, HTML/CSS, JavaScript, and Flask

courses.title: Programming, Data Structures and Algorithms Using Python
courses.fees: Free (₹1,000 optional exam fee for IIT Certificate)
courses.eligibility: College students and learners pursuing college degrees or technical entrance exams.
courses.about: Official National Programme on Technology Enhanced Learning (NPTEL) certified course by IIT Madras faculty covering core data structure design.
youLearn: Computational complexity, big-O notation, asymptotic analysis
Lists, stacks, queues, binary search trees, and heaps
Sorting algorithms, graph representations, and dynamic programming

courses.title: Google Data Analytics Professional Certificate
courses.eligibility: No prior experience or college degree required.
courses.about: Hands-on curriculum engineered by Google data scientists preparing learners for in-demand junior data analyst positions.
youLearn: Data cleaning and spreadsheet calculations in Google Sheets & Excel
Database querying with SQL in BigQuery
Data visualization in Tableau and statistical programming with R

courses.title: Statistics and Probability Mastery
courses.eligibility: Open to all students building mathematics intuition.
courses.about: Comprehensive, visual mastery of statistical theory essential for data analytics, machine learning, and AI model evaluation.
youLearn: Descriptive statistics, variance, standard deviation, and z-scores
Probability distributions, binomial, and normal bell curves
Hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, p-values, and linear regression

scholarships.title: National Scholarship Portal (NSP) Post Matric Scholarship
scholarships.provider: Ministry of Electronics & Information Technology / Ministry of Minority Affairs
scholarships.eligibility: Enrolled in recognized undergraduate/postgraduate degree. Minimum 50% in previous qualifying exam with family income under ₹2.5 LPA.
scholarships.documents: Aadhaar Card, Previous Marksheet, Income Certificate from competent authority, Bank Passbook, College Fee Receipt.

scholarships.title: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girl Students
scholarships.provider: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
scholarships.amount: ₹50,000 per year for entire course duration
scholarships.eligibility: Female students admitted to 1st year of technical degree/diploma in an AICTE approved institution. Family annual income less than ₹8 LPA.
scholarships.documents: 10th & 12th Marksheet, AICTE College Allotment Letter, Annual Family Income Certificate, Bank Account in applicant name.

scholarships.title: Reliance Foundation Undergraduate Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: First year regular full-time undergraduate students from any stream with minimum 60% in Class 12. Household income below ₹15 LPA.
scholarships.documents: Class 12 marksheet, household income proof, college admission proof, aptitude test score.

scholarships.title: Tata Trusts Means & Merit Higher Education Grant
scholarships.amount: Full or Partial Tuition Support (up to ₹1,50,000)
scholarships.eligibility: Students pursuing engineering, medicine, sciences, and professional streams in recognized Indian universities with stellar academic records.
scholarships.documents: Income tax returns/salary slips, university bonafide certificate, semester grade cards, fee structure document.

internships.title: National Internship Portal - Digital India Internship
internships.location: New Delhi / State Capital NIC Centers
internships.eligibility: Indian students pursuing B.Tech/M.Tech/MCA/B.Sc. with minimum 60% cumulative aggregate.
internships.roleOverview: Contribute to national public digital goods, e-governance platforms, Aadhaar/UPI ecosystem microservices, and cyber resilience systems.
internships.requirements: Proficiency in Java, Python, REST APIs, database querying, and strong analytical reasoning.

internships.title: Flipkart Leap Internship Program
internships.eligibility: Pre-final and final year students in CS/IT/Data Science disciplines.
internships.roleOverview: Collaborate with senior software and data engineers to build high-scale logistics tracking, checkout pipelines, and recommender systems.
internships.requirements: Data Structures & Algorithms, Python/Java, SQL, problem-solving curiosity for high-volume transactions.

internships.title: Product Design & UX Internship
internships.eligibility: Design, HCI, or multimedia undergraduate students with an active Figma portfolio.
internships.roleOverview: Design consumer micro-interactions, refine instant delivery map tracking UI, and run moderated usability testing sessions.
internships.requirements: Deep proficiency in Figma, design systems, wireframing, and empathy for consumer behaviors.

internships.title: Computer Vision & Robotics Research Intern
internships.eligibility: Engineering students in 2nd, 3rd, or 4th year with foundational machine learning coursework.
internships.roleOverview: Collaborate with doctoral faculty on deep neural networks for autonomous agricultural drone imagery and drone obstacle avoidance.
internships.requirements: Python, PyTorch, OpenCV, matrix calculus, clean git hygiene.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (TCS National Qualifier Test)
jobs.eligibility: Graduating Batch 2025/2026 with 60% throughout 10th, 12th, and Degree without active backlogs.
jobs.roleOverview: Develop, test, and maintain enterprise software solutions across banking, healthcare, telecom, and cloud infrastructure.
jobs.requirements: Foundational aptitude, coding in C++/Java/Python, OOPs principles, SQL databases.

jobs.title: Software Developer & ML Trainee
jobs.eligibility: Open to any degree or discipline; selection is strictly based on practical coding and problem-solving aptitude.
jobs.roleOverview: Design core web microservices, build real-time collaborative editors, and train applied NLP models for Zoho Office Suite.
jobs.requirements: Exceptional mastery of Data Structures, C/Java/Python programming, and algorithmic design.

jobs.title: Specialist Programmer & Systems Engineer
jobs.eligibility: B.E/B.Tech/M.E/M.Tech in any engineering stream with strong coding skills.
jobs.roleOverview: Architect microservices, optimize cloud databases, and work on client-facing generative AI platforms.
jobs.requirements: Algorithmic problem solving (LeetCode medium/hard), REST APIs, Docker, and full-stack familiarity.
